source.name: Emirates Media Centre, 'Emirates FA Cup Title Partnership Extended Until 2028'
source.note: Sponsor's own press release (fetched 25 Sep 2026): four-year extension from the start of 2024/25, competition 'will continue to be called the Emirates FA Cup until 2028'; partnership first began in 2015. Value not stated in the release.

note: Title sponsor since 2015, renewed 2018 and 2021, extended 1 Aug 2024 for four years through 2027-28. Sportcal (1 Aug 2024, fetched) reported the renewal at about GBP 10m a season, down from about $18.5m under the 2021 deal - press estimate, so upTo true.
